footerWhy.f1: Four columns: brand, categories, collections and info links.
footerWhy.f2: One row: wordmark and every link inline, with a legal line below.
footerWhy.f3: Link rows above a giant wordmark, sized to fit the width.
footerWhy.f4: Inverted colours: a newsletter form beside categories and collections.
footerWhy.f5: Three fact cards above the usual columns.
footerWhy.f6: Link rows above an inverted, giant wordmark.
footerWhy.f7: Три колонки посилань у рамці, ряд значків доставки й оплати, далі юридичний рядок.

headerWhy.h1: Burger menu left, wordmark centre, search, region, account and cart on the right.
headerWhy.h2: Wordmark left, up to four category links centred, utilities on the right.
headerWhy.h3: A slim promo line above a main row with the wordmark, menu and search.
headerWhy.h4: The header fills with the accent colour, wordmark left, menu centred.
headerWhy.h5: A slim bar plus a scrollable row of category chips with product counts.
headerWhy.h6: The same category chip row as Slim, but the bar keeps the wordmark centred.

heroWhy.g: A split hero: a product's photo beside its title, price and an add-to-bag button.
heroWhy.ga: A carousel of category slides, the active one wider, with neighbours peeking in.
heroWhy.gb: Vertical category stripes; the selected one expands to show its own copy.
heroWhy.h: A three-product shelf beside a panel naming the collection and its starting price.
heroWhy.j: Three large category tiles with item counts, in place of a hero image.
heroWhy.k: A flat accent band with a headline, subheadline and one call to action.
heroWhy.l: A full-bleed photo with a floating card for one product in the bottom-left corner.
heroWhy.m: No image — a two-line tagline strip above the first collection's heading.
heroWhy.none: No hero — the page opens straight into the next section.

listingWhy.none: No listing — the page ends after the hero and tiles.
listingWhy.p1: One collection, four columns, eight products, title and price shown.
listingWhy.p2: All products, six columns, a dense grid of twelve, title and price only.
listingWhy.p3: A row list with image, title, a spec line and price for each product.
listingWhy.p4: A three-column masonry wall of nine products, image, title and price.
listingWhy.p5: One large lead product beside four smaller ones, editorial layout.
